entries.title: Ezekiel 15:1
segments:
CHAP. XV. 
 
  God by the similitude of a vine, foreshews the utter destruction of   Jerusalem, ver. 1-8.

entries.title: Ezekiel 15:2
segments: V. 2. The vine-tree-Israel is here compared to a vine, which, when fruitless, is utterly unprofitable.  This the prophet minds them of to humble them, and awaken them to fruitfulness.  A branch-One branch of a tree in the forest is of more use than the whole vine-tree is, except for its fruit.

entries.title: Ezekiel 15:3
segments: V. 3. A pin-Will it afford even a pin to drive into a wall or post, on which you may safely fasten any weight.

entries.title: Ezekiel 15:4
segments: V. 4. For fuel-When for its barrenness it is cut down, it is fit only to burn.

entries.title: Ezekiel 15:6
segments: V. 6. Given-Doomed for food to the fire.

entries.title: Ezekiel 15:8
segments: V. 8. Because-They have been so perpetually trespassing, that it seems a continued act.
